capabilities: Search movies and series by title or IMDB ID via the OMDb API
Generate notes from a customizable template with prefix, suffix, regex, and JavaScript string transforms
Embed YouTube trailers using the optional YouTube Data API key
Save movie poster images locally as jpg files
Preserve user content below a delimiter when overwriting existing notes
extras: The README includes a disclaimer that the search selection preview uses outside assets (movie posters) retrieved from OMDb; it also documents an optional custom CSS snippet and Dataview card view for displaying the generated notes, and notes that the card view requires country, year, length, and trailer_embed fields.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up movie or series metadata and turn it into notes with structured properties.

relations.evidence: Uses the Open Movie Database (OMDb) API to retrieve movie/series data
the Youtube Data API to get the embed links for the trailers (optional)
Using a dataview table in combination with a custom css snippet, you can use these notes

summary: Template-based note generator that fetches movie and series data from the OMDb API and writes it into properties for Dataview.
